# Microsoft 365 Copilot
> AI-powered Microsoft 365 app for work that combines chat, search, content creation, and task automation.

Microsoft 365 Copilot helps people and organizations chat with AI, search across work data, create documents and presentations, and automate workflows across Microsoft 365.

## Core Experience
- [Microsoft 365 Copilot Home](https://m365.cloud.microsoft/): Main entry point for the Microsoft 365 Copilot web app.
- [Meet Microsoft 365 Copilot](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365-copilot): Overview of Copilot capabilities, scenarios, and product positioning.
- [Copilot Chat](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365-copilot/chat): Dedicated page for AI chat experiences in Microsoft 365 Copilot.
- [AI Agents](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365-copilot/agents): Overview of agent-based automation and task execution in Copilot.
- [Daily Prompt Guide](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365-copilot/learn-copilot-today): Prompting tips and daily examples for getting more from Copilot.
- [Plans and Pricing](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365-copilot/pricing): Pricing and licensing information for Microsoft 365 Copilot.

## Microsoft 365 for Home
- [Compare Microsoft 365 Products](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/buy/compare-all-microsoft-365-products): Compare Microsoft 365 plans and features for individual and family use.
- [Microsoft 365 Family](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/p/microsoft-365-family/cfq7ttc0k5dm): Family subscription plan with productivity apps, storage, and security features.
- [Microsoft 365 Personal](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/p/microsoft-365-personal/cfq7ttc0k5bf): Single-user subscription plan for apps, cloud storage, and AI features.
- [Microsoft 365 Premium](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/p/microsoft-365-premium/cfq7ttc11z3q): Premium consumer plan with advanced productivity and protection capabilities.
- [Explore Microsoft 365 for Home](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/explore-microsoft-365-for-home): Overview of Microsoft 365 experiences and benefits for home users.

## Copilot Learning
- [Learn Copilot Today](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365-copilot/learn-copilot-today): Guided prompts and examples for everyday Copilot use cases.
- [Copilot Chat](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365-copilot/chat): Learn how conversational AI supports work tasks and information retrieval.
- [AI Agents](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365-copilot/agents): Learn how agents can automate workflows and complete multi-step tasks.

## Product Navigation
- [Home](https://m365.cloud.microsoft/): Sign in to access chat, search, creation, and automation features.
- [Meet Copilot](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365-copilot): Product overview page linked from the main navigation.
- [Pricing for Business](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/business/microsoft-365-plans-and-pricing): Business pricing page linked from the main navigation.
- [Pricing for Enterprise](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/enterprise/microsoft-365-plans-and-pricing): Enterprise pricing page linked from the main navigation.
- [Pricing for Individuals](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/buy/compare-all-microsoft-365-products): Consumer pricing comparison page linked from the main navigation.
